scheme_name: State Technical Scholarship for ST Student
other_conditions: Applicant must not be an employee of any government or semi‑government establishment.
Applicant must be pursuing a diploma, degree, or post‑graduated course in an engineering institute recognised by AICTE, or an undergraduate/postgraduate course in Forestry.
Applicants pursuing courses other than those specified are not eligible.
Applicants receiving more than one scholarship in the same academic year will be disqualified.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance is provided for up to 3 years for diploma courses, 4 years for degree courses, and 2 years for postgraduate engineering courses.
